summary: The creator chooses to craft the Raging Wildfire - Helm+ mythic piece from the Piece of Treasury event's furnace forging. This helmet grants Defense Penetration based on adjacent allied heroes in the same row and column. He intends to use this gear piece across Dauntless, Aura, and Corrosion team builds. For its substat allocations, he selects Attack %, HP %, Crit Rate %, and puts 5 points directly into Crit Damage.
tips: When crafting the Raging Wildfire - Helm+, invest 5 points into Crit Damage along with Attack %, HP %, and Crit Rate % substats to maximize damage for Dauntless, Aura, and Corrosion lineups.
title: Don't Waste Your Materials! 🔥 Mythic Forging | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
